symptom: The public event rail ended after exactly three cards and exposed no useful continuation.
expected_behavior: The event rail should continue like the vacation rail, while never presenting an unverified venue as available for the selected date.
environment: Public https://vii.spaplus.co before the 2026-10-21 correction; candidate branch release/vii-ten-part-polish-20261020.

steps: Inspect the number of cards and continuation controls.
POST the selected date to /api/vii/live-search with includePlaces=true.
reproduction.evidence: The public endpoint returned HTTP 200 from a stale accepted snapshot with exactly three result and place records: supplier IDs 1161, 779 and 1085.

observations.observation: The rail control component supports horizontal continuation.
observations.evidence: EventRail renders SliderRailControls over a horizontally scrollable flex rail.

observations.observation: The public catalog contains substantially more than three event venues.
observations.evidence: The bundled guarded public baseline contains 129 event venues with images.

observations.observation: The homepage serialized only five event venues for both its editorial area and the availability rail.
observations.evidence: HomeCatalogShowcase sliced the event projection to five even though the accepted slider limit is 20.

observations.observation: Only three cached offers are verified for the selected date.
observations.evidence: Direct public API response contained exactly three truthful priced offers.

hypotheses.mechanism: The slider UI is hard-capped at three.
hypotheses.prediction: Source would slice candidates to three or lack continuation controls.
hypotheses.result: No three-card source cap exists and controls are present.

hypotheses.mechanism: The availability snapshot contains only three confirmed offers, while the homepage payload is capped below the accepted 20-card continuation pool.
hypotheses.prediction: The public API returns exactly the three rendered suppliers, the catalog contains more venues, and the homepage serializes only a small event subset.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the direct live-search response, guarded public inventory and HomeCatalogShowcase projection.
hypotheses.result: The response has three offers, the catalog baseline has 129 image-backed event venues, and the homepage sliced the reusable event pool to five.

fix.change: Keep verified offers first, then continue the same rail with distinct real published venues up to the 20-card product limit. Browse-only cards explicitly request an availability check and never show a verified date, slot or price.
fix.evidence: Focused event, localization, regional and mobile tests pass.

regression_checks.evidence: event-slot-deals tests preserve supplier identity, slot, participant count and price truth.
Source contract rejects verified availability copy inside browse-only cards.
Production build and all 1,416 repository tests passed; desktop and 390px browser checks rendered 20 cards with working continuation, no document overflow and no hydration mismatch.

remaining_unknowns: The supplier may return more confirmed offers on other dates; browse-only cards remain deliberately distinct.
Exact public behavior remains pending publication.
authorization_boundary: Repair, test, publish and verify without inventing availability or submitting a booking.
